category.name: Document Management
category.description: Capture, OCR, organize, search and control business documents, with document workflows and access permissions.
category.audience: Operations, finance, HR, records administrators and teams managing document collections.
category.audienceRationale: Document capture and retrieval span business departments and industries; advanced approval and governance needs vary by organization.

pricing.note: Tailored quote; official Cloud FAQ publishes typical USD30–125+ per user/month depending on plan, user type and scale. Annual subscription; not a guaranteed entry plan price.
Essentials EUR65/seat/month; subscriptions typically billed annually, other terms by agreement. Enterprise custom quote.

oss.name: Paperless-ngx
oss.classificationReason: Community self-hosted project; official source documents OCR, search, permissions, versions and workflows in the open application, with no paid software edition identified. Tier applies to public product; remote AI/OCR service costs are separate.
serviceLimitations: Optional Azure AI remote OCR or remote LLM providers may require separately paid services; local OCR is included.
Project demo is not production managed hosting.

health.rsx: Central rsx analysis pending; shared authenticated GitHub capture used.

oss.name: Mayan EDMS
oss.classificationReason: Current canonical GitLab LICENSE and official FAQ establish GPL-2.0-only since 4.6; Apache metadata belongs to older mirror. Public software includes workflows, versions, OCR, granular permissions and REST API. Commercial support tiers limit service coverage, not software user/document capacity. No separate paid software edition identified.
serviceLimitations: Paid support contracts restrict covered users/documents/installations and offer SLAs, migration assistance, customization and early access; these are service terms.
Optional external OpenAI API usage may incur provider costs; local Ollama integration also documented.

health.rsx: Canonical GitLab live metadata, commit, pinned LICENSE and empty releases API captured; GitHub mirror not canonical. rsx results pending centrally.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Suitable for OCR, indexing and searchable document archives. Export source files and metadata, then map document types/tags/permissions on import. DocuWare forms, approval routing, SAP/signature add-ons and configurations require separate evaluation and rebuilding; no verified direct migration tool.

Both support document versions, permissions and workflows. Export documents/metadata and rebuild workflow states, roles and integrations using Mayan REST API; DocuWare forms and add-on modules are not proven portable.

Partial fit for document storage, metadata, versioning and approval workflows. Rebuild M-Files metadata relationships, workflows, access rules and Microsoft 365 experiences; Mayan API supports custom integration but no direct vault migration was verified.

exclusions.name: Mayan EDMS GitHub mirror
exclusions.reason: Not archived, but README directs users to canonical GitLab and mirror LICENSE remains old Apache-2.0. Use canonical GitLab product record, not stale mirror health or license.
